image_metadata.caption: Louis Blériot (1872–1936) became the first to fly across the English Channel with an airplane on July 25, 1909. (Image courtesy of {{% resource_link "efebc95a-3dcb-4345-a903-b4d16e37cb87" "Tom Wigley" %}} on Flickr. License: CC BY-NC-SA.)
image_metadata.image-alt: The image is a painting of a yellow old-time airplane flying across a blue ocean. At the lower left bottom is a portrait of the pilot with a name of Louis Bleriot written around the portrait.
